>of names, I hate Vicissitude and don't know its cards AT ALL).

Body Arsenal (superior) and Horrid Form both give the vampire +1
strength, not +1 hand damage, so will add to the damage done by a
Kraken's Kiss strike (strength+1 ranged damage).

However, the Agg enhancement given by the inferior level of Body
Arsenal will not be applied to the strength ranged damage of Kraken's
Kiss, as it is only for hand strikes, which as we have established
Kraken's Kiss is not.

Kraken's Kiss [SW:C/PT]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Vicissitude
[vic] Strike: strength+1 ranged damage. If this striking minion takes
more than 3 damage this combat, he or she goes to torpor.
[VIC] As above, with an optional press, only usable to continue
combat, and once each round for the remainder of combat, this vampire
may strike to steal two blood at close or long range.

Horrid Form [Sabbat:U, SW:PT]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Vicissitude
Only usable before range is chosen.
[vic] This vampire gets +1 strength for the remainder of combat.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage each round for
the remainder of combat.

Body Arsenal [Sabbat:C, SW:PT2]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Vicissitude
[vic] For the remainder of this round, damage from this vampire's hand
strikes is aggravated.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire gets +1 strength for the remainder of
this combat.

Meaning Stutter Step (superior) is a hand strike (as well as being a
dodge strike), which is why Immortal Grapple got clarified. Instead of
only being able to play hand strikes, you are not allowed to play
strikes that aren't hand strikes. Which only makes a difference in the
case where a strike is both a dodge and a hand strike at the same
time: Stutter Step.
